name: agents
description: Pets in Still Room, Review Queue, Delegation Guard and Mission Board: subagents, unreviewed work, model policy with spend by tier, and plan progress across all agents. Replaces agent-pets.

mod_pets_enabled.title: Pets
mod_pets_enabled.description: Enable the pets mod (pane, pets button).

mod_mission_enabled.title: Mission Board
mod_mission_enabled.description: Enable the mission board mod (also mission.enabled).

mission_enabled.title: Mission Board (alias)
mission_enabled.description: Same switch as mod.mission.enabled; false turns the mod off.

minBandRows.title: Min band rows
minBandRows.description: Below this many free rows the band row is hidden.

pets_mascots.title: Mascots
pets_mascots.description: auto and on draw the Pom/Carrot stills; off draws the block mark.

pets_terminalStills.title: Terminal stills
pets_terminalStills.description: Reserved: draw stills in kitty/Ghostty terminals (not implemented yet).

pets_maxRuns.title: Max runs
pets_maxRuns.description: Runs kept in the pets list.

pets_maxDone.title: Max done shown
pets_maxDone.description: Finished pets shown in the pane.

pets_autoOpen.title: Auto open
pets_autoOpen.description: Open the pets pane once, on the first spawn of a session.

showChecklist.title: Checklist band
showChecklist.description: Show the TodoWrite/TaskCreate checklist in the band (awareness Now Doing owns it by default).

review_remindMin.title: Remind after (min)
review_remindMin.description: Minutes before the review segment shows the oldest age and a warn edge.

review_includeBackfilled.title: Queue backfilled agents
review_includeBackfilled.description: Also queue agents first seen through the live agent list.

review_toast.title: Review toast
review_toast.description: Reserved: no toast is raised by default.

delegation_mode.title: Guard mode
delegation_mode.description: warn toasts, deny blocks a model-less Agent call, off only tracks spend. /delegation overrides and persists.

delegation_allowTypes.title: Allowed types
delegation_allowTypes.description: Comma globs of agent types that pin their own model.

delegation_toast.title: Guard toast
delegation_toast.description: Toast on a model-less spawn in warn mode.

nesting_mode.title: Nesting guard mode
nesting_mode.description: warn toasts when a subagent starts a subagent, deny refuses the call, off ignores it. /delegation nesting overrides and persists.

nesting_allowTypes.title: Nesting allowed types
nesting_allowTypes.description: Comma globs of agent types a subagent may start.

nesting_toast.title: Nesting toast
nesting_toast.description: Toast on a nested spawn in warn mode.

runaway_maxSteps.title: Runaway steps
runaway_maxSteps.description: Warn when one subagent reaches this many steps (0 = off).

runaway_maxContext.title: Runaway context
runaway_maxContext.description: Warn when one subagent step reaches this many context tokens (0 = off).

runaway_toast.title: Runaway toast
runaway_toast.description: Toast when a runaway threshold fires (the row mark and band segment always show).

pricesJson.title: Prices override
pricesJson.description: JSON {"asOf":"YYYY-MM-DD","opus":{"input":..,"output":..,"cacheRead":..,"write5m":..}} per MTok. Empty = built-in table.

windowsJson.title: Context windows override
windowsJson.description: JSON {"asOf":"YYYY-MM-DD","sonnet":200000,"opus":1000000} tokens per family (or a model-id substring). Empty = built-in table.

mission_stepLine.title: Spawn line
mission_stepLine.description: Append the progress line to every subagent prompt.

mission_stepVia.title: Step channel
mission_stepVia.description: tool = deferred mcp__agents__step; bash = echo MISSION_STEP n/m.

mission_maxTiles.title: Max tiles
mission_maxTiles.description: Clickable tiles in the pane before a +N more button.

mission_specGlobs.title: Spec globs
mission_specGlobs.description: Comma globs of plan/spec files discovered from edits.
